consumer.after: one wsp_clamp :: (v: $T: ordered, low: $T, high: $T) -> $T; 3 water-spectrum calls (int and f32) and waterlab's 7 calls use it, with literal bounds taking the bound type (wsp_clamp(dt, 0, 0.1))

The byte growth is the instance names and the moved source-map ranges.
before_after.peak_memory_note: compile and check peak RSS differ by under 3%, within run-to-run noise on a loaded host
